fields.Name: T179 - Open Competitions via Entity Search
fields.Description: Verifies that the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box can locate and open the Competitions entity, displaying its grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box to open the Competitions entity: type 'Competitions' into that box and click the node named EXACTLY 'Competitions' (NOT 'Competition Entries' or 'Competition Judges'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron and do NOT use the Ctrl+K global search box. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is reached when the Competitions entity grid is open and displayed in the Data Explorer Data section.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Search entities...' sidebar box was used to find the Competitions entity
The 'Competitions' entity is selected and its grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
The grid renders correctly with rows OR a valid empty-state (no crash)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
